Odin × Godot

Odin × Godot: desk reference

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
The engine boundaryKitReplayThree contracts to keep separateRun from the repository rootReading orderExported diagrams

Kit and Replay are independent frameworks. Kit starts from script entities and field declarations. Replay starts from a complete replayable simulation frame. Both have cooperative and authoritative prediction paths. Replay is experimental.

The engine boundary#

Godot owns the editor, scene tree, input devices, rendering and audio. An Odin script is a struct and free procs attached to a node. self addresses the script struct; self.owner addresses the engine node.

scripts/*.odin → scriptgen → Odin compiler → scripts library

The core GDExtension registers Odin with Godot and loads that scripts library. Pure Replay gameplay packages also run without Godot.

Kit#

  • gd:"replicate": authority-written state.
  • gd:"owner": cooperative owner-written streams, interpolated remotely.
  • gd:"predict,interp" and @(gd_tick): server-authoritative sim lane.
  • @(gd_command): target mutation with generated submission and verdict handling.
  • Predicted commands mutate only their target. Cross-entity consequences belong in the authority command hook after acceptance.
  • Start with examples/hello_net, then compare examples/hello_sim.

Replay#

step(frame at T, input for T+1) → frame at T+1 + occurrences

  • World contains mutable gameplay dependencies: health, positions, bags, RNG, cooldowns, scheduled work, entity lifetime and allocation metadata.
  • Keep node pointers, sockets, resources, live audio and storage outside World.
  • A step reads its state, input, tick and immutable versioned definitions.
  • Emit occurrences in the step. Present Begin/Update/Confirm/Cancel outside it.
  • revise_input replaces a local recorded input batch. It does not establish network authority.
  • correct ingests a complete verified authority frame and its occurrences, then stages the speculative suffix before committing the operation.
  • Timeline: local simulation. Session: direct network roles. Party → Room: invitations and authority recovery. P2P_Party plus the admitted peer runner: deterministic fixed-roster rollback.

Three contracts to keep separate#

  1. Authority: whose result may settle the game?
  2. History: which values must be restored to compute the next tick?
  3. Presentation: which frame and occurrences should this screen display?

Client-filtered visible state is not a complete authority migration backup. A new epoch scopes occurrence identities; it does not elect a legitimate host. Saving body poses does not make Godot contact solving replayable.

Run from the repository root#

Shell
# Local restore/replay and independent reference comparison:
nix develop --command bash examples/replay_loot/run.sh

# Same model with a Godot view. Space revises the pickup winner:
nix develop --command bash examples/replay_hello/play.sh loot

# Kit's predicted movement example, headless behavior check:
nix develop --command bash examples/hello_sim/run.sh

# Replay authority, two clients and observer under injected delay:
nix develop --command bash examples/replay_hello/network_run.sh

Reading order#

  1. docs/getting-started.md: extension and scripts library wiring.
  2. docs/kit/quickstart.md: field/entity/command authoring.
  3. docs/kit/quickstart-sim.md: promote owner motion to authoritative motion.
  4. examples/replay_loot/game/game.odin and main.odin: complete local model.
  5. replay/getting-started.md: runners and scene/session lifecycle.
  6. examples/replay_recipes/README.md: checked lifecycle recipes.
  7. docs/replay/framework-audit.md: implementation and tested support scopes.

Exported diagrams#

  • diagrams/two-models.svg: authoring models.
  • diagrams/engine-boundary.svg: compiler, extension and scene boundary.
  • diagrams/kit-pickup.svg: target prediction and authority consequences.
  • diagrams/frame-boundary.svg: frame dependencies and external owners.
  • diagrams/authority-path.svg: client prediction and authority correction.
  • diagrams/correction.svg: restore and replay a suffix.

The website's JavaScript model is an illustration. It does not run Odin, use a transport, or establish performance or platform support.
